levels.title: The Locked Flank
levels.intro: Unlock the gate or circle behind the guard. Avoid the top patrol.
notes: kit name L37_LOCKED_FLANK_V2_UNREACHABLE_PATROL (handoff "LEVEL-37", 2026-11-11), base hint LEVEL-30
Design: main guard g1 faces West at [6,4]. The front approach from [4,4] is illegal/detected; rear approach from [8,4] is the only way to KO g1 and reach exit [6,2].
Main guard g1 is mandatory. The only physical approach to exit [6,2] is through g1 node [6,4]; [8,2] and exit are not connected.

The upper guard g2 is a 3-node pingPong patrol [2,2]->[3,2]->[4,2] and back. This 3-node component has NO movement connection to the player-accessible component, regardless of whether the locked gate opens. Thus a knockout is physically impossible; no guard immunity flag or special exception is used.

Even though g2 cannot be approached, sight passes through empty ground: at the right endpoint facing E it sees exit [6,2] at distance 2; at the left endpoint facing W it sees [0,2]. Timing matters with before/after sight checks.
Key + gate route: [2,4],[2,6],[4,6] key,[6,6],[8,6] gate,[8,4],[6,4] KO g1,[6,2] exit (8 counted moves).

No-key lower detour example: [0,2],[0,4],[2,4],[2,6],[2,8],[4,8],[6,8],[8,8],[8,6],[8,4],[6,4] KO g1,[6,2] exit (12 counted moves), using two extra actions to align the exit with the patrol blind phase.

No-key upper approach example: [0,2],[0,0],[2,0],[4,0],[6,0],[8,0],[8,2],[8,0],[8,2],[8,4],[6,4] KO g1,[6,2] exit (12 counted moves). Returning to [8,0] and back uses movement, not WAIT, to synchronize the final exit.
Bespoke 9x9 puzzle, 24 nodes, all walkway cells are valid, no WAIT, 2-square guard sight, no cameras. Candidate pending official Unity C# solver verification.

C# engine note (2026-11-11): a ping-pong guard at its first route node faces the endpoint at t=0 (here W, watching (0,2)), unlike the kit prototype (E); the kit's two 12-action no-key routes are caught on their first step, but a 12-action no-key route still exists (E S N S S E E E N N KO N). Par 8 via key + gate; no knockout-free route (as designed); patrol g2 unreachable with the gate open or closed.
Knockout-only design (D-078): the exit is reachable only through g1, so no knockout-free (legacy Stealth) route exists; intended.
